pages.text: The Rite of the Forest is a medium ritual working for raising a grove where none stood before. Drop the sapling for the kind of woodland you want at the center of the circle, then prepare the rite as you would any other altar-fed working.$(br2)Oak, spruce, birch, jungle, rowan, alder, and hawthorn each answer to their own real sapling again, so the rite can finally raise Witchery groves instead of stopping at ingredient stand-ins.

The rite wants more than the trigger sapling. Offer a $(item)Wicker Bundle$(), a $(item)Brew of Sprouting$(), and an $(item)Ent Twig$() around the circle, and keep at least $(bold)4000 altar power$(/) ready to spend.$(br2)If a bound waystone is offered and lies close enough, the grove may be raised there instead of around the casting circle.

pages.title: Why It Matters
pages.text: This rite is how a witch quickly claims a living stand of the exact trees the craft keeps asking for. Rowan for protection, hawthorn for purity, alder for misfortune, or the common woods for bulk.$(br2)If you intend to explore deeper plantcraft, awaken Ents, or move toward the more dangerous living-wood paths later, learn this rite early.
